title: Watercolor Procreate Brush Set
author: FinsandFiction
description:
Create soft, realistic watercolor artwork directly in Procreate with this premium watercolor brush toolkit designed for illustrators, artists, content creators, and digital creatives.
This brush set was carefully created to mimic the look and feel of traditional watercolor painting with soft blooms, natural texture, layered transparency, watercolor paper grain, and painterly brush strokes.
Perfect for:
• Botanical illustrations
• Fruit and food artwork
• Journaling and sketchbooks
• Surface pattern design
• Stationery and invitations
• Social media artwork
• Digital illustrations
• Creative business projects
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT’S INCLUDED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• 13 Watercolor Brushes
• 3 Blending Brushes
• 2 Flat Brushes
• 1 Sketch Brush
• 1 Ink Liner Brush
• 4 Canvas Texture Brushes
• 4 Watercolor Color Palettes (.swatches)
• 4 Canvas Textures
• PDF Installation & Usage Guide
Total: 20 Procreate Tools
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COMPATIBILITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✓ Works ONLY with Procreate on iPad
✓ Apple Pencil recommended
✓ iOS compatible
NOT compatible with:
• Photoshop
• Illustrator
• Canva
• Desktop software
• Other drawing apps

FEATURES
